name: quirk-activation-burst
intent: Eight hard triangular ray wedges burst from core; STANDBY swaps to ACTIVE with stamp.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Immediately show ACTIVE core and stamp; no wedge burst

waveC: Hard ink ray wedges at frozen angles, ACTIVE stamp on settle
acceptance: Eight triangular ray wedges burst at frozen 45deg intervals over 480ms
STANDBY swaps to ACTIVE with stamp on 280ms settle
Ray width 22px, length 46% from core center
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows ACTIVE core and stamp immediately
No network; burst clipped to host
